import markdown

# Check what the footnotes postprocessor does to heading content
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc", "footnotes"])
source = "# Header with footnote[^1]\n\n[^1]: footnote text\n"

# Convert and see the full output
result = md.convert(source)
print("=== Full HTML ===")
print(result)

# Check the ElementTree structure
print("\n=== Tree structure ===")
for elem in md.parser.root.iter():
    print(f"Tag: {elem.tag}, Text: {elem.text!r}, Tail: {elem.tail!r}")
    for child in elem:
        print(f"  Child: {child.tag}, Text: {child.text!r}")
